diagnosis: step 1 (docs/pivot/evidence/tailcap-floor-diagnosis/diagnosis.json): the 2018-19 shortfall of +tailcap75 at h = 1 is +0.1649, 94% of it on days that are not risk dates; the floor's start-up carries none of it (no pressure day falls before the floor can be fitted); a short training window accounts for about a third (the same row on a later stretch of equal length: +0.0570); every 2018-19 day is in scarcity state 3; the pooled floor lags a rate that rises within the year
